name: What types of replacement glass are available for foggy windows?

mainEntity.name: What types of replacement glass are available for foggy windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: When replacing foggy glass, you have various options beyond standard clear glass. Common choices include Low-E (low-emissivity) glass, which helps improve energy efficiency by reducing heat transfer, and tempered glass, which is stronger and shatters into small, safer pieces if broken, often required for safety in certain areas. Other options include tinted glass for sun control, obscure glass for privacy, or even laminated glass for enhanced security and sound reduction. Your contractor can guide you on the best type for your specific needs and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available replacement glass types include Low-E for energy efficiency, tempered for safety, tinted for sun control, and obscure or laminated for privacy and security.
